wholePhysicalScope: The named worship site and Bhawan establish location. Selected 2026 Overture building outlines establish the approximate visible wings and nearby public pavilions.
lodDetails: Four levels preserve the layered Bhawan buildings and covered approach. Closer levels add divided galleries and window rows.
limitations: The reconstruction covers publicly visible buildings of the Holy Bhawan. The cave interior, distant pilgrimage gates and the separate Bhairon Temple are outside its scope.
Footprints come from aerial-derived Overture vector geometry. Individual block names, roofs behind the main frontage, façade heights and floor levels are approximate.
The covered approach is a partial exterior based on the mapped hillside track and photos. Its framing and deck elevations are estimated.
The original source terrain is kept independent. The source-scale elevation field cannot resolve the real retaining benches at each floor level.
